ab_a.description: incumbent recall: default child config with the local embedding sidecar (fast-bge-base-en-v1.5)

ab_b.description: challenger: FTS-only recall, no embedding sidecar

description: Pre-registration for the recall-embeddings proof (kit-memory-study-vce comment 204 section D: --pairs 12 --mem-rounds 4 --repeats 2 = 25 legs, B 144 facts / A 156 facts, about 8 h, one heavy-slot job). Same main model both arms; the contrast is embeddings vs FTS recall only. The one sound receipt so far (ab-memory-embeddings-vs-fts-20261002-side) is a 5-leg pilot: recall at ceiling both arms, FTS numerically faster on pre_main but within noise. This proof asserts the kit-v8t gates for candidate ab_a (embeddings): Fisher-pooled non-inferiority at margin 0.10 on recall and derail, plus a drift-paired t win on recall pre_main_s (PowerPlan B: neighbour pairing cancels the within-run drift and needs 6-8 pairs; 12 are run). If the data says FTS is faster, the recall-faster assertion fails and the proof refutes: that is a valid close. Dataset, frozen-omp, and verdict conventions are the same as mnemopi-extraction__proof. Single direction only: nobody claims FTS wins, so no reverse receipt. Evaluated by prove.evaluate_memory_metric and prove.evaluate_sized_design; alpha lives in the verdict row (STATS_ALPHA), not the spec.
